event_names.24: profile_skip: id 0..3 actual skip; 4..7 mismatch/read error; a=skipped,b=request generation,c=version
event_names.26: activation boundary snapshot; header id=255, then numbered MMIO readbacks
event_names.27: registration control, local timing and response enqueue audit
event_names.28: OMCI GEM candidate and QoS fields
event_names.29: OMCI original provider error and failing stage
event_names.30: Native OMCI TX: id 1 admission-drop,2 submit,3 DMA-complete,4 descriptor-drop,5 teardown-abort,6 DMA-error,7 admission-retry. a=TCI/type/device, b=class/entity, c=GEM/length, d=native epoch low32. Headers only; no optical acknowledgement.
event_names.31: GWAN append: id 1 begin,2 end; a=kind bits (1 GEM,2 T-CONT,4 first service,8 classifier,16 RX-only metadata),b=added channel bitmap,c=added GEM count,d=channel bitmap. id 3 GEM readback: a=GEM,b=expected,c=actual valid/type/TX-encryption bits,d=old/new RX flags; result errno.
event_names.32: Public OMCI topology: id 1 upload count; 2 upload header; 6 Set header after its response; 3..5 data words. Classes 171/262/277/278 only. Set response correlation requires matching stack, generation, TCI, class, entity and attribute mask.
event_names.33: service-install: 1 selection (old/new rules, first-service eligibility); 2 QoS read (a=sample-sequence<<5|channel,b=mode,c=units); 3 verified write result; 4 install outcome (old/new rules, live path, stage); 6/8 read weights and 7/9 write weights packed u16 pairs with matching sample/channel token; errors never assert valid readback; id 11 VLAN compile: a=entity<<16|rule,b=policy<<24|inner filter PCP<<20|outer filter PCP<<16|remove<<12|inner treatment PCP<<8|inner mode<<4|outer mode,c=input/output TPID,d=inner/outer VID; result errno.

limitations: IRQ timestamp identifies a local deferred batch, not each optical arrival
Internal TX counters and power readings cannot certify individual optical bursts or OLT acceptance
Hardware upstream MIC cannot be captured; audits verify inputs and host vectors only
Narrow EqD and live-key modes are experimental, immutable per module load and checked before use
Missing critical evidence or incomplete register blocks remain inconclusive
Deactivate is always honored; no forced O5 or ignored OLT reset

omci_reconfiguration.runt_exception: Both RX guards; OMCI only; exact length, GEM/session and MIC checked by authenticator
omci_reconfiguration.pending_response_policy: Unchanged authenticated epoch may wait above DMA admission, maximum 128 queued packets and original 1000 ms deadline. Rekey/reset still purges old work.
omci_reconfiguration.native_admission_race: Authenticated OMCI preserves skb on transient closure/stale native epoch; retry checks auth epoch and original 1000 ms deadline. Data cannot acquire a replacement epoch.
omci_reconfiguration.live_add_policy: Bits 0/1: append empty GEM/T-CONT entries. Bit 2: first data classifier only, unchanged namespace, all data queues closed, target native mappings absent. OMCC remains live. Bit 3: classifier updates with unchanged bindings, used channels, queue masks and scheduler configuration. Resource rebinding/removals/reset/keys retain full retirement.

omci_topology.upload: All descriptor-backed readable attributes, split into 26-byte attribute-aligned blocks; PQ mask fff0, scheduler f000.
omci_topology.dot1x: Read-only module selector bench_dot1x_oem; strict default. Factory comparison validates enable 0..1 and write-only action 1..3 and stores controls; no authenticator or PAE success claimed.
omci_topology.queue_binding: Same-T-CONT scheduler or null direct strict-priority bank. Zero weights allowed only under SP. Cross-T-CONT, mixed direct/WRR and zero WRR weights rejected.

omci_service.large_sp_weight: Store 0..255 under SP without hardware update. Native QDMA weight field is 16 bits; WRR accepts OMCI 1..255 exactly, rejecting zero/direct bindings. Hardware service validation pending.
